title: Entropy on Homogeneous Spaces and Classification Results for Subgroups with the Pair Rapid Decay Property
summary: We study pair rapid decay for homogeneous spaces \(G/H\) and its applications to random walks and subgroup structure. The entropy framework for groups with rapid decay is extended to homogeneous spaces, proving that the asymptotic Shannon entropy on \(G/H\) agrees with a spectral-radius quantity \(c(G,H;μ)\) for measures with finite entropy and suitable finite moment, and that the lower and upper asymptotic Rényi entropy rates converge to the Shannon entropy as \(α\downarrow1\). For finitely supported measures, we also obtain a spectral-radius formula for the asymptotic Rényi entropy rates…
